endpoint.text: SVR12, defined as HCV RNA < LLOQ (target detected or target not detected) at post-treatment Week 12

citations.quote: The primary objective of study AI444218 was to demonstrate that the combination therapy with DCV and SOF for 12 weeks is safe and effective in treatment-naïve (TN) or PR treatment-experienced (TE) subjects chronically infected with HCV GT-3 based upon SVR12, defined as HCV RNA < LLOQ [target not detected (TND) or target detected (TD)] at post treatment Week 12.
ALLY-3 was an open-label trial that included 152 subjects with chronic HCV genotype 3 infection and compensated liver disease who were treatment-naive (n=101) or treatment-experienced (n=51).

result.text: Overall SVR12 89% (135/152; 95% CI 83%, 93%); 90% (91/101) in treatment-naive and 86% (44/51) in treatment-experienced; SVR12 lower in cirrhotic (63%, 20/32) vs non-cirrhotic (96%, 115/120) subjects

citations.quote: Study AI444218 was a global study that enrolled 152 subjects from 2 countries; 96% (146/152) of subjects were from US sites and only 4% (6/152) subjects were from Puerto Rico. The overall SVR12 was 89% (135/152) with 95% confidence interval (CI) of (83%, 93%). The SVR12 rate was 63% (20/32) with 95% CI of (44%, 79%) for subjects with cirrhosis at baseline, and 96% (115/120) with 95% CI of (91%, 99%) for subjects without cirrhosis at baseline.

indication.text: DAKLINZA is indicated for use with sofosbuvir for the treatment of patients with chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) genotype 3 infection; SVR rates are reduced in genotype 3 patients with cirrhosis treated for 12 weeks

citations.quote: DAKLINZA is indicated for use with sofosbuvir for the treatment of patients with chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) genotype 3 infection [see *Dosage and Administration* (2) and *Clinical Studies* (14)].
Sustained virologic response (SVR) rates are reduced in HCV genotype 3-infected patients with cirrhosis receiving DAKLINZA in combination with sofosbuvir for 12 weeks [see *Clinical Studies* (14)].

target_moa.text: Daclatasvir is an inhibitor of HCV nonstructural protein 5A (NS5A); it binds to the N-terminus of NS5A and inhibits both viral RNA replication and virion assembly

citations.quote: DAKLINZA (daclatasvir) is an inhibitor of HCV nonstructural protein 5A (NS5A).
Daclatasvir is an inhibitor of NS5A, a nonstructural protein encoded by HCV. Daclatasvir binds to the N-terminus of NS5A and inhibits both viral RNA replication and virion assembly.
Dosage Forms / Strength	60 mg and 30 mg tablets for oral use

description.text: Expanded indication to include genotype-1 chronic HCV patients co-infected with HIV-1, and added dosing for genotype-3 HCV/HIV-1 co-infected patients

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application proposes to expand the indication to include the treatment of subjects with genotype-1 chronic hepatitis C virus infection, including subjects who are co-infected with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV-1) based on the results from the ALLY-2 clinical trial. In addition, dosage recommendations are added to include treatment of HCV genotype 3 subjects who are co-infected with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV-1). The labeling is also updated with drug-drug interaction information, including information for buprenorphine/naloxone and multiple HIV antiviral agents.

description.text: Expanded to include treatment of chronic HCV genotype 1 with compensated or decompensated cirrhosis and genotype 3 with decompensated cirrhosis

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application proposes to expand the patient population to include the treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus genotype 1 infection in subjects with compensated (Child-Pugh A) or decompensated (Child-Pugh B or C) cirrhosis and treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus genotype 3 infection in subjects with decompensated (Child-Pugh B or C) cirrhosis.
